dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: It's an egg that lets you test your fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: They contain all sorts of dishes and desserts from all over Natlan, but they all look the same from the outside.

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: Each guest can receive a free Gift Egg once per day, and as for what they get, it all boils down to luck!

dialogues.speaker: Challwa
dialogues.text: Oh, I should mention that there are also special secret editions.
